service.description: Internal: the one-time code of a text, or none: 4 to 8 digits on word boundaries (one space or dash inside allowed, or after a "G-" style prefix) within 40 characters of a keyword (chat_otp_keywords, comma separated, else English: code, verification, OTP, passcode, PIN, login, 2FA and the like), not part of a phone number, a price or amount, a date or time, a year or a link; two candidates as near are none. strong: it is the text's only candidate.

Internal (Sms.js, after an incoming text was taken in): the message's code kept as content.otp {code}; a strong code's message disappears a day after it was sent (expireDate) when every local member of the room has CHAT_OTP_DELETE Y. Nothing for a message that is no outside text or has no code. The update is pushed. Out: code, expireDate.

A member keeps a code's message that was to disappear after a day: its expireDate cleared and pushed. Refused: not a member (notFound), no code (notFound), a room with a disappearing timer (roomTimer: the room's timer is not one member's to take back). Out: kept, reasonCode.

The caller's own choice to block screenshots while a room is open (ChatRoomMember.screenSecure), whatever CHAT_SCREEN_SECURITY says; on false clears it. Refused for a room the caller is not in. Out: screenSecure.

The current user's chat privacy settings: screenSecurity (CHAT_SCREEN_SECURITY: off, encrypted (while an encrypted room is open) or app (the whole app), Android's FLAG_SECURE) and otpDelete (CHAT_OTP_DELETE, Y: a text's one-time code disappears a day after it came, when everyone in its room asks the same). A setting not given stays.

parameter.name: fromForm
parameter.description: The settings form: an empty otpDelete (its check box off) is N
